_note: How the game LOOKS and FEELS: animation, hit effects, particles, UI motion and backgrounds. Nothing here changes the rules or balance. Times are in seconds, sizes in screen pixels unless they say tiles. Set a strength to 0 to switch an effect off.

characters._note: The animals. class_badge_radius: the class icon under each one, in pixels. shader_enabled false is the lighter option for slow phones (no shader at all; hits flash with a plain tint). shader_* values drive the per-animal shader (scripts/fx/unit.gdshader): a warm highlight on the edge facing the light (top-left), a cool rim light on the far edge, outlines recolored to a dark shade of the animal's own color, and a little extra color punch.

combat._note: Combat juice. Hit-stop briefly pauses the whole fight on strong hits (a hit doing at least strong_hit_pct of the target's health, a charge, a pounce or a dive). Shake is in pixels.

effects._note: Particles. max_particles caps how many can be on screen at once (lower it on slow phones).

crowd._note: Keeping big fights readable and smooth. A fight is crowded from crowded_from_units animals on the field: bursts use particles_when_crowded of their particles, ordinary hits lose their claw and bite marks, fewer sparks and numbers show, and (plain_animals_when_crowded) the animals skip their shader so many of a kind draw together; that look is chosen as the herds come on, not mid-fight. Hit sparks: at most hit_sparks_max bursts at once (hit_sparks_when_crowded when crowded), each counting for spark_seconds; when that many are showing, a bigger hit takes the place of the smallest. Damage numbers work the same way (combat number_max_on_screen; numbers_when_crowded when crowded).

camera._note: The fight's camera. When the field grows for bigger herds (draft_rules.json "field"), the camera zooms out to it over about zoom_seconds.

celebrations._note: Big moments. After each fight the new score pops up over the field (score_pop_size) and flies into the score bar. A 3-star animal gets a slow-motion zoom (zoom in, hold, zoom out, with the field's animation slowed by star3_slow_motion), stars, confetti and a bouncy 3 STARS!, then keeps a gold glow (gold_glow) with a sparkle every gold_sparkle_seconds. Flawless: winning a round without losing an animal. Comeback Victory: winning the match after being 2 rounds down.

rivals._note: Rival Rangers. The VS screen before a match (versus_seconds before it goes on by itself, 0 to wait for a tap; it can't be tapped away before versus_min_seconds), and the rival's emote bubbles in the match (shown for emote_seconds, at most one every emote_gap_seconds). Beating a boss plays its celebration for boss_celebration_seconds before the result shows.

ui._note: Buttons and tappable cards squash when pressed and spring back with an overshoot (big panels squash less); popups and the Draft Duel panel pop in. Numbers in pills tick to their new value over count_seconds; short messages over the field stay for toast_seconds. A tap shows tap_sparkles sparkles; the main button on a screen breathes (breathe_amount, breathe_seconds); brass and gold icons catch a glint every glint_seconds; shop cards bob gently (card_bob_pixels, card_bob_seconds) and pop in stagger_seconds apart; a bought card flies to your herd (fly_seconds, along an arc fly_arc_pixels high) and lands with a squash (land_squash) and land_puffs puffs of dust.

pick._note: The Pick 3 screen. Card sizes are [width, height] in game pixels: option_card for the five options, start_card for round 1's collection grid, herd_card for your herd row; slot_size for the three pick slots, undo_badge for the back arrow on your latest pick. Hold a card hold_seconds to see its details. After a fight, the result shows for result_seconds before the next round's picks. The opponent takes between the two bot_pick_seconds over each pick.

grade._note: A warm afternoon grade over the whole game, darker toward the edges (a gentle vignette). Colors are in ui_style.json (grade_center, grade_edge); strength 0 turns it off without removing it.

transition._note: Changing screens: a leafy circle closes (cover_seconds) with a swirl of leaves, then opens on the next screen (reveal_seconds).

background._note: The arena behind the fight: a little calmer than the animals so they pop, with gentle motion.
